speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any fluctuation in your symptoms throughout the day, such as worsening weakness or double vision towards the evening? Have you noticed any drooping of your eyelids or difficulty swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any difficulty swallowing or slurred speech, and have you noticed any drooping of your eyelids, especially later in the day? I would also like to check for ptosis and perform a repeat strength test after you have been looking upward for a minute to see if weakness worsens with sustained effort.

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had recent infections or fevers, and there is no family history of neurological disease. The weakness feels symmetrical in both arms and legs.

speaker: Doctor
text: The elevated antibodies strongly suggest Myasthenia Gravis, but the normal Edrophonium test is unusual. Do you have any difficulty breathing or shortness of breath, especially when lying flat? I will also request a CT scan of your chest to rule out a thymoma. REQUEST TEST: Chest_CTomography

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chest_CT: Normal, no thymoma or other masses detected.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal Edrophonium test is atypical for classic Myasthenia Gravis, so I need to investigate other causes. Do you have any sensory changes, such as tingling or numbness, and have you experienced any recent viral illnesses or vaccinations? I will also request an MRI of your brain and spine to check for multiple sclerosis or other structural lesions. REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain_and_Spine

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the MRI is normal and acetylcholine receptor antibodies are present, the normal Edrophonium test may be a false negative or indicate a less common variant. I will request a repeat electromyography to look for the characteristic decremental response in your muscles. REQUEST TEST: Repetitive_Nerve_Stimulation_EMG

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Repetitive_Nerve_Stimulation_EMG: Decreased muscle response with repetitive stimulation

speaker: Doctor
text: The decremental response on EMG, combined with elevated acetylcholine receptor antibodies and fluctuating weakness, confirms the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis
